description: This file implements device type analysis and propagation for TorchScript graphs, including rules for setting device types on tensors and propagating device information through graph nodes.

classes.name: DeviceTypePropagationPass
classes.description: A class that performs device type propagation analysis on a TorchScript graph, applying rules to set device types on tensors based on graph nodes.

methods.name: setDeviceType
methods.description: Sets the device type for a tensor value if it differs from the current device.

methods.name: setReturnsToDevice
methods.description: Sets the device type for all outputs of a node.

methods.name: setReturnstoDeviceRule
methods.description: Creates a propagation rule for a specific device type.

methods.name: returnFirstArgDeviceRule
methods.description: Rule to set device based on the first argument tensor.

methods.name: returnSecondArgDeviceRule
methods.description: Rule to set device based on the second argument tensor.

methods.name: isZerodimCPUTensor
methods.description: Checks if a tensor type is a zero-dimensional CPU tensor.

methods.name: propWithNoDevice
methods.description: Propagates device info when no explicit device argument is present.

methods.name: defaultDeviceProp
methods.description: Default rule to propagate device info based on schema or inputs.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the device type propagation pass on the graph.

methods.name: propagateNode
methods.description: Processes a node to propagate device type information.

methods.name: processAtenOps
methods.description: Handles ATen operator nodes for device propagation.

methods.name: buildRuleRegistry
methods.description: Builds a registry of custom rules for specific ATen operators.
